title: Dungeon MeshNode wrappers + dungeon_2d.dsl example
description: Thin MeshNode wrappers that expose the pure algorithms from PROCGEN-3 and PROCGEN-4 to the DSL runtime. Each wrapper is annotated @MeshNodeAnnotation(scopes = {"dungeon"}) — NOT the default {"mesh", "dungeon"} — so they only appear in dungeon-scoped graphs and never leak into Daud's mesh-modeling catalog (verified via PROCGEN-1 filter). Five nodes: RandomRoomsNode (seed, grid_w, grid_h, count, min_size, max_size -> rooms:ROOM_LIST), DelaunayGraphNode (rooms -> edges:EDGE_GRAPH), MinimumSpanningTreeNode (edges, room_centers, extra_edge_prob, seed -> edges:EDGE_GRAPH), AStarCorridorsNode (rooms, edges, grid_w, grid_h, reuse_cost, empty_cost, room_cost -> tiles:TILE_GRID), DungeonGridToMeshNode (tiles, cell_size -> mesh:MESH). Each wrapper delegates to the corresponding algo class — keep wrappers thin, no algorithm logic here. Create an example graph at ixdar-app/src/main/resources/dsl/dungeon_2d.dsl that chains all five nodes and produces a renderable dungeon mesh.
definition-of-done: 1. Five MeshNode classes in ixdar.procgen.dungeon.nodes, each with scopes = {"dungeon"}. 2. Wrappers delegate to algo classes and contain no algorithm logic. 3. dungeon_2d.dsl parses successfully via NodeGraphRuntime. 4. Running dungeon_2d.dsl end-to-end produces a non-empty ArrayMesh. 5. Daud catalog isolation: call the mesh-DSL catalog tool with scope="mesh" (PROCGEN-1), grep for random_rooms / delaunay_graph / minimum_spanning_tree / astar_corridors / dungeon_grid_to_mesh — expect zero matches. This is the load-bearing correctness check for the scope system.
testing-plan: 1. Unit test: each wrapper's execute() produces the expected value type. 2. Integration test: load dungeon_2d.dsl with NodeGraphRuntime, execute, assert mesh has >0 vertices and >0 triangles. 3. Determinism: run dungeon_2d.dsl twice with the same seed, diff the output mesh bytes — identical. 4. Scope isolation (critical): Daud mesh-DSL catalog tool invoked with scope="mesh" must return zero dungeon nodes; invoked with scope="dungeon" returns all five.
